The capabilities and robustness of the proposed implementation are demonstrated by simulating the ``Nine Circles of Elastic Brittle Fracture'' on a silicate glass --- a set of tests that span the entire range of well-settled experimental knowledge on fracture nucleation and propagation. These simulations also serve to illustrate the deployment of the code using several native Abaqus finite elements, including the simplicial elements CPS3, CAX3, and C3D4.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了Kumar-Francfort-Lopez-Pamies相场断裂模型在Abaqus中的用户子程序实现，采用交错求解，并通过“九圆”算例验证其能力与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 为在Abaqus中可靠实现考虑材料强度面的相场断裂模型，避免整体求解可能导致的错误物理结果，并提供可复现的用户子程序方案。
AI.method: 针对各向同性线弹性脆性材料与Drucker-Prager强度面，输入E、ν、单轴抗拉强度、单轴抗压强度和断裂韧性Gc；利用热方程与相场演化方程的数学对应，通过UMAT将驱动力c_e作为热源；结合UEXTERNALDB、UAMP、MPC和URDFIL实现位移场与相场的交错求解，并用MPC和URDFIL通过原始-对偶主动集法施加相场边界与不可逆约束。
AI.result: 在硅酸盐玻璃上模拟“九圆弹性脆性断裂”系列算例，覆盖从裂纹萌生到扩展的实验知识范围，并展示CPS3、CAX3、C3D4等Abaqus原生单元的使用。
AI.conclusion: 该实现能够稳健地求解相场断裂问题，并适用于多种Abaqus有限单元类型。

title: Multi-property Feynman-Kac Steering of Crystal Diffusion Models
summary: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful priors for generating new materials, including inorganic crystals, but generating useful materials requires satisfying specific chemical and physical properties, from mechanical stiffness to bandgaps. Existing approaches either retrain models for new target properties or steer only the atom coordinates and lattice during generation, leaving composition unchanged despite its fundamental role in determining physical properties. We present FK-ReMask, an inference-time, gradient-free method that steers both the continuous and discrete channels of a pretrained crystal diffusion model. During generation, FK-ReMask maintains multiple denoising trajectories and replicates promising candidates using Feynman-Kac particle selection. However, selection alone is insufficient: in the atom-type channel, committed elements cannot be revised, so cloning propagates existing compositions and limits the population's ability to explore new ones. We address this with an atom re-masking mechanism, which reopens committed sites during the generation process and allows alternative compositions to emerge. Across four electronic, photovoltaic, and mechanical objectives, our method improves the yield of SUN (stable, unique, novel) and property-on-target materials. We further demonstrate joint steering of three photovoltaic properties, showing that multiple physical objectives can be specified entirely at inference time without retraining.

AI.tldr: FK-ReMask 是一种无需训练、无需梯度的推理时方法，可同时引导预训练晶体扩散模型的连续通道（坐标/晶格）和离散通道（原子类型），从而生成满足多种目标性质的新材料。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型能生成无机晶体，但要获得有用材料需满足力学、电子、光伏等特定性质；现有方法要么针对新性质重新训练模型，要么仅引导原子坐标和晶格而保持成分不变，忽略了成分对物理性质的根本作用。
AI.method: 在生成过程中维护多条去噪轨迹，利用 Feynman-Kac 粒子选择复制有希望的候选；针对原子类型通道中已确定元素无法修改导致克隆传播既有成分的问题，引入 atom re-masking 机制，在生成过程中重新开放已确定位点，使替代成分得以出现，从而同时引导连续和离散通道。
AI.result: 在四类电子、光伏和力学目标上，该方法提高了稳定、唯一、新颖（SUN）材料及性质达标材料的产率；并展示了在推理时联合引导三种光伏性质，无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明可在推理阶段对预训练晶体扩散模型进行多目标性质引导，且对成分通道的探索对生成性质达标材料至关重要；无需针对新目标重新训练即可指定多个物理目标。

title: Universal scaling and measurability limits of thermal-conductivity measurement by a nanoscale point contact
summary: Thermal conductivity ($\kappa$) measurement of a thin film is critical for developing thermal management materials in heterogeneous systems. A nanoscale point contact method based on scanning thermal microscopy (SThM) offers a unique approach to probe $\kappa$ with nanoscale spatial resolution in sub-100 nm thick films. Extracting $\kappa$ of a thin film from this method requires separating film, substrate, and interface contributions that are comparable in magnitude. Multiple unknowns make this extraction a high dimensional problem. In this work, we used dimensional analysis to reduce the number of variables to provide physical insights into the realistic bounds of $\kappa$ measurement. We show that the total tip-sample thermal resistance $R_{ss}$, originally a function of six variables, reduces to four independent dimensionless groups. These groups are used to construct a mathematical relation that captures the dependence of $R_{ss}$ on the governing parameters. The resulting analysis shows that the point contact tip-film-substrate problem is governed by a single dimensionless invariant, $\Omega = R_{ss}\kappa_{\mathrm{sub}}t$, and two control parameters: the confinement ratio $t/b$ and the thermal contrast $\kappa_{\mathrm{sub}}/\kappa_{\mathrm{film}}$. From the invariant, we derive an amplification factor, set only by the contact geometry and the interfaces, that converts the uncertainty of a measurement into an uncertainty in the extracted conductivity. This factor scales with the ratio of the parasitic interface resistance to the film's sheet thermal resistance and bounds the film conductivity that a given contact can resolve. We apply the framework to a 14$\pm$1 nm Al film grown on SiO$_2$ to locate the measurement within the established bound. The framework then lets us map its thermal resistance with sub-100 nm spatial resolution and recover the local thermal conductivity.

AI.tldr: 该工作用量纲分析简化SThM纳米点接触测薄膜热导的反演问题，建立由单一不变量和两个控制参数支配的框架，并在14±1 nm铝薄膜上验证。
AI.motivation: 亚100 nm薄膜热导测量对异质系统热管理材料至关重要，但SThM点接触法需分离薄膜、基底和界面贡献，多个未知量导致高维反演困难。
AI.method: 采用量纲分析将总探针-样品热阻R_ss从六个变量缩减为四个独立无量纲群，并构建R_ss与主导参数间的数学关系；进一步导出由接触几何和界面决定的放大因子，用于将测量不确定度映射为提取热导的不确定度并界定可分辨范围。
AI.result: 点接触针-膜-基底问题由单一无量纲不变量Ω=R_ss κ_sub t及两个控制参数——限制比t/b和热对比κ_sub/κ_film——支配；放大因子随寄生界面热阻与薄膜薄层热阻之比缩放，并给出给定接触可分辨的薄膜热导边界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架应用于SiO2上14±1 nm Al薄膜，可将测量定位在已建立边界内，并以亚100 nm空间分辨率映射热阻、恢复局部热导。

title: Strong Thermal Conductivity Suppression in Isotope Purified Single Crystal Diamond with Phonon Scatterings of Color Centers
summary: The thermal conductivity of natural diamond can be further improved by ~50% by eliminating isotope impurity to obtain pure 12C diamond. However, unlike isolated point defects, how color centers scatter phonons and correspondingly limit the thermal conductivity remain poorly understood. Here, we report the thermal conductivities of two isotope-purified diamond with different Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) color center concentrations, confirmed by photoluminescence (PL) and secondary-ion mass spectrometry (SIMS). Results show ~ 3200 W m-1 K-1 and ~ 2100 W m-1 K-1 for two samples of low and high NV concentrations, respectively. Modified Callaway model analyses show that first-principles-derived scattering parameters can reproduce room-temperature thermal conductivity of the high NV concentration sample under a vacancy concentration assumption (~30% of the total Nitrogen concentration), but fail to reproduce its temperature dependence. Compared to PL and SIMS results, which show ~7.1-fold NV concentration and ~92-fold difference in total Nitrogen concentration between two samples, suggesting the assumed 30% vacancy fraction may be greatly overestimated. Taken together, these results suggest that NV-color-center defects may scatter phonons more strongly than models treating Nitrogen and vacancy as independent point defects, providing new insights into color-center-induced phonon-scattering mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该文测量了两种不同氮-空位（NV）色心浓度的同位素纯化金刚石的热导率，发现低NV样品约3200 W m^-1 K^-1、高NV样品约2100 W m^-1 K^-1，并表明NV色心对声子的散射强于将氮和空位视为独立点缺陷的模型。
AI.motivation: 天然金刚石通过去除同位素杂质可获得约50%热导率提升，但色心如何散射声子并限制热导率仍不清楚，尤其是NV色心与孤立点缺陷的差异尚缺乏理解。
AI.method: 制备两种不同NV色心浓度的同位素纯化金刚石，用光致发光（PL）和二次离子质谱（SIMS）确认NV及总氮浓度；测量室温热导率，并用改进Callaway模型结合第一性原理散射参数分析，其中假设空位浓度约为总氮浓度的30%。
AI.result: 低NV和高NV样品的室温热导率分别约为3200 W m^-1 K^-1和2100 W m^-1 K^-1；模型在高NV样品中采用约30%空位假设可复现室温热导率，但不能复现其温度依赖关系。PL和SIMS显示两样品NV浓度相差约7.1倍、总氮浓度相差约92倍，说明30%空位比例可能被严重高估；结果提示NV色心缺陷的声子散射强于将氮和空位作为独立点缺陷处理的模型。
AI.conclusion: NV色心缺陷可能具有比独立氮/空位点缺陷更强的声子散射效应，这为色心诱导的声子散射机制提供了新认识，并说明仅用独立点缺陷假设可能不足以描述NV金刚石的热输运。

title: HEXRD and HEXRDGUI: a flexible toolkit for X-ray diffraction analysis in dynamic compression experiments
summary: This article describes the application of HEXRD, an open-source Python library for X-ray diffraction analysis, and HEXRDGUI, its companion graphical application, to dynamic compression experiments. Built on a generic multi-detector geometric model, the toolkit supports arbitrary instrument configurations with independently positioned planar or cylindrical detector panels, arbitrary beam directions, and multiple X-ray sources. It calibrates instruments from powder rings, Laue spots or the rings of an unknown phase, fits whole patterns by Le Bail or Rietveld refinement, and imports data from the TARDIS, FIDDLE and PXRDIP platforms at the National Ignition Facility (NIF) and OMEGA EP. Although originally developed for high-energy diffraction microscopy at synchrotron sources, HEXRD has been adopted as an analysis tool for dynamic compression X-ray diffraction experiments at facilities including the NIF, the Matter in Extreme Conditions end-station at the Linac Coherent Light Source, the Dynamic Compression Sector (DCS) at the Advanced Photon Source, OMEGA EP at the Laboratory for Laser Energetics, and the High Energy Density (HED) instrument at the European XFEL. Calibrated from the same ring positions on a single planar detector, HEXRD and the independent code pyFAI predict the same scattering angle 2$\theta$ to numerical precision. On a dual-source dataset from the NIF, calibrating the detectors against both X-ray sources at once fits the rings of both to an RMS of 0.18{\deg} in 2$\theta$, about one image-plate pixel, whereas a fit to either source alone, with the plate tilts held at their nominal values, fits its own rings nearly as well but mispredicts the other's by about 0.6{\deg}. The software is freely available under a BSD license.

AI.tldr: HEXRD 与 HEXRDGUI 是用于动态压缩 X 射线衍射实验的开源分析工具，支持任意多探测器几何、仪器校准、全谱拟合及 NIF/OMEGA EP 等平台数据导入。
AI.motivation: 动态压缩 X 射线衍射实验需要能处理任意探测器布局、多 X 射线源和多种标定/拟合流程的通用分析软件，并支持 NIF、LCLS-MEC、DCS、OMEGA EP、European XFEL HED 等装置。
AI.method: 基于通用多探测器几何模型，支持独立定位的平面或圆柱探测器面板、任意光束方向和多个 X 射线源；可由粉末环、Laue 斑点或未知相环标定仪器；支持 Le Bail/Rietveld 全谱拟合；可导入 TARDIS、FIDDLE、PXRDIP 数据；并与 pyFAI 进行散射角一致性比较。
AI.result: 在单平面探测器同一环位置标定下，HEXRD 与 pyFAI 预测的 2θ 在数值精度内一致。NIF 双源数据同时标定两个 X 射线源时，两套环的 2θ RMS 为 0.18°，约一个成像板像素；仅拟合单一源且板倾角保持标称值时，本源性拟合接近但会以约 0.6° 误预测另一源。
AI.conclusion: HEXRD/HEXRDGUI 可作为动态压缩 X 射线衍射的通用开源分析工具，已获多个大科学装置采用，并以 BSD 许可证免费发布。

title: Extrinsic Bulk Photovoltaic Effect from Asymmetric Defect Scattering
summary: The extrinsic bulk photovoltaic effect from asymmetric electron-defect scattering can make an important contribution to the total photocurrent and is highly diagnostic of defect type. We present an ab initio Boltzmann framework combining optical excitation with electron-phonon and symmetric and skew electron-defect scattering, and we apply it to monolayer GeS. Because the defects that generate the current also relax the anisotropy that sustains it, the response peaks at a finite defect fraction. Within the scattering-limited model, cooling to $0$~K shifts the peak position toward lower defect fractions and yields a maximum enhancement of more than six orders of magnitude at fixed defect fraction. At selected low-temperature defect fractions, the total extrinsic current can exceed the intrinsic shift current by more than an order of magnitude, so that the defect fraction itself becomes a tunable parameter.

AI.tldr: 该文建立从头算玻尔兹曼输运框架，统一处理光激发、电子-声子散射及对称/偏斜电子-缺陷散射，揭示单层GeS中由非对称电子-缺陷散射产生的外在体光伏电流可在低温与有限缺陷分数下显著增强并超过本征位移电流。
AI.motivation: 外在体光伏效应中的非对称电子-缺陷散射对总光电流有重要贡献，且可用于诊断缺陷类型；但需要将光激发与多种散射机制统一描述，以定量理解缺陷分数和温度对光电流的影响。
AI.method: 构建从头算玻尔兹曼输运框架，将光学激发与电子-声子散射、对称电子-缺陷散射和偏斜电子-缺陷散射相结合，并应用于单层GeS。
AI.result: 产生电流的缺陷同时会削弱维持电流的各向异性，因此响应在有限缺陷分数处达到峰值；在散射受限模型中，降温至0 K使峰值移向更低缺陷分数，并在固定缺陷分数下实现超过六个数量级的最大增强；在选定的低温缺陷分数下，总外在电流可超过本征位移电流一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷分数本身可成为可调参数；非对称电子-缺陷散射主导的外在体光伏效应在单层GeS中可显著超过本征位移电流，表明缺陷工程与低温条件可有效调控体光伏响应。

title: Electric Hidden Unconventional Collinear Magnetism in 2D \(\mathcal{PT}\)-Symmetric Antiferromagnets
summary: Electric hidden unconventional collinear magnetism, in which a perpendicular electric field (\(\mathcal{E}_z\)) lifts the \(\mathcal{PT}\)-enforced degeneracy and selectively releases the hidden crystallographic constraints in conventional 2D antiferromagnets to drive emergent magnetic phases, has remained largely unexplored. Here we establish a complete symmetry classification of all 88 collinear spin layer groups (cSLGs) compatible with conventional \(\mathcal{PT}\)-symmetric antiferromagnets, and show that the \(\mathcal{E}_z\) drives the system into three distinct classes of unconventional collinear magnetism: type-IV magnetism (Class-I, 23 cSLGs), altermagnetism (Class-II, 34 cSLGs), and fully compensated ferrimagnetism (Class-III, 31 cSLGs). We illustrate these categories using the most common and feasibly exfoliable 2D candidate materials. These include Sr$_2$CaCr$_2$P$_2$O$_9$ and Sr$_2$CaCr$_2$As$_2$O$_9$ (Class-I), BaMnGe and MnPS$_3$ (Class-II), and Sr$_3$Fe$_2$O$_5$Cl$_2$ and bilayer MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ (Class-III). We further demonstrate that the \(\mathcal{E}_z\) generates distinctly different spin-splitting fingerprints across the three classes, yielding distinct spin-dependent responses: the electric Hall effect in Class-I, spin-polarized transport in Class-II, and the electric reversible magneto-optical Kerr effect in Class-III. Our work not only closes a complete internal cycle from conventional to unconventional collinear magnetism in 2D antiferromagnets, but also establishes a viable all-electrical compensated magnetism platform and control scheme for future spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 该文建立88个共线自旋层群（cSLGs）的完整对称性分类，揭示垂直电场可打破PT简并，将常规PT反铁磁体驱动为三类非常规共线磁性，并给出材料实例与全电学响应。
AI.motivation: 电场诱导的隐藏非常规共线磁性，即通过垂直电场解除PT强制简并并选择性释放晶格约束以产生新兴磁相，此前 largely unexplored；需要系统对称性分类和可实现的二维材料平台。
AI.method: 对所有与常规PT对称反铁磁体兼容的88个共线自旋层群进行完整对称性分类，并用常见且可剥离的二维候选材料展示三类磁性；进一步分析电场下的自旋劈裂指纹与自旋依赖响应。
AI.result: 电场驱动三类非常规共线磁性：Class-I为type-IV磁性（23个cSLGs），Class-II为altermagnetism（34个cSLGs），Class-III为完全补偿亚铁磁性（31个cSLGs）。代表材料包括Sr2CaCr2P2O9/Sr2CaCr2As2O9（Class-I）、BaMnGe/MnPS3（Class-II）、Sr3Fe2O5Cl2/双层MnBi2Te4（Class-III）。三类分别呈现电场霍尔效应、自旋极化输运和电场可逆磁光克尔效应等不同自旋劈裂指纹。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完成了二维反铁磁体中从常规到非常规共线磁性的完整内部循环，并建立了可用于未来自旋电子学的全电学补偿磁性平台与调控方案。

title: Electronic structure, magnetic order and anisotropic magnetoresistance in $\mathbf{Eu_{1-x}Gd_xCd_2P_2}$ (0 $\le$ x $\le$1)
summary: Recently, $\text{EuCd}_2\text{P}_2$ has attracted increased attention for its colossal magnetoresistive (CMR) property, the mechanism of which seems to deviate from that of known canonical CMR compounds such as manganites. Many studies underscore the role of low density of hole carriers caused by Eu vacancies, particularly in stabilizing ferromagnetic (FM) order and modifying electrical transport and magnetoresistive responses in this compound. A magnetic polaron based mechanism rather than double exchange based mechanism is being proposed to explain the CMR effect for this compound. In this work, we explore the effect of elctron doping on the magnetic transition and CMR behaviour via Gd substitution at Eu sites with varying concentration (x) in Eu$_{1-x}$Gd$_{x}$Cd$_2$P$_2$. Our Density Functional Theory (DFT) and Monte Carlo-based calculations reveal an oscillating ground state magnetic order as a function of electron carrier density. The ground state is found to be A-AFM metal for x=0.056, 0.125 and 0.5 while it becomes ferromagnetic metal at x= 0.33, 0.67 and 1. Most importantly, we predict colossal anisotropic magnetoresistance in this compound for x=0.125 and 0.5. The underlying mechanism of anisotropic CMR in this compound looks similar to double exchange like due to the presence of a strong intra-site 4\textit{f}-5\textit{d} ferromagnetic exchange interaction and an itinerant electron in the hybridized conduction states. The oscillating ground state magnetic order and the enhancement of transition temperature (as high as 150K for x=0.67) as a function of electron carrier density offers a new avenue to tune the magnetotransport property in this compound and offers an excellent platform for designing future spintronics devices.

AI.tldr: 该文通过Gd替代Eu进行电子掺杂，结合DFT与Monte Carlo计算研究Eu_{1-x}Gd_xCd_2P_2的磁基态与庞磁电阻行为，发现磁序随电子载流子密度振荡，并预测x=0.125和0.5时存在巨各向异性磁电阻。
AI.motivation: EuCd_2P_2因庞磁电阻（CMR）受到关注，其机制不同于锰氧化物等典型CMR材料；已有研究强调Eu空位导致的低空穴载流子密度对铁磁序稳定及输运/磁阻响应的作用，并提出磁极化子机制而非双交换机制。本文旨在通过Gd替代引入电子掺杂，调控载流子密度并考察磁转变与CMR行为。
AI.method: 在Eu位引入不同浓度Gd形成Eu_{1-x}Gd_xCd_2P_2，采用密度泛函理论（DFT）与基于Monte Carlo的计算，系统研究电子载流子密度对基态磁序、磁转变温度和磁输运性质的影响。
AI.result: 计算表明基态磁序随电子载流子密度呈振荡变化：x=0.056、0.125和0.5时为A型反铁磁金属；x=0.33、0.67和1时转为铁磁金属。特别地，预测x=0.125和0.5时出现巨各向异性磁电阻。其各向异性CMR机制类似双交换，源于强 intra-site 4f-5d 铁磁交换作用与杂化导态中的巡游电子。电子掺杂还可显著提高转变温度，x=0.67时可达约150 K。
AI.conclusion: 电子载流子密度可有效调控EuCd_2P_2体系的基态磁序、磁转变温度和磁电阻响应，并产生可观的各向异性CMR；该结果为该材料的磁输运性质调控及未来自旋电子器件设计提供了新途径和理论平台。

title: Long-lived nonequilibrium spin configuration induced by dual optical excitation
summary: The ability to create and control nonequilibrium spin states is central to understanding ultrafast magnetism and to developing optical routes for manipulating magnetic materials beyond conventional thermal pathways.In metallic systems, photoexcited electronic distributions rapidly evolve toward quasi-thermal states through efficient electron-electron and electron-phonon scattering, making long-lived modification of spin-dependent interactions difficult to achieve. Here, we investigate coherent magnetization precession in an amorphous GdFeCo thin film driven by simultaneous excitation with two femtosecond laser pulses.Using a symmetric dual-pump geometry that continuously evolves from single-pulse to spatially periodic excitation, we separate effects associated with the excitation pattern from those arising from simultaneous dual-pump excitation. We identify a narrow excitation window in which the lifetime of the ferromagnetic-resonance-like mode increases strongly while its frequency exhibits a small but reproducible increase.Time-window analysis shows that the enhanced lifetime persists for several hundred picoseconds, substantially longer than transient magnetostatic effects associated with the periodic excitation pattern.The combined frequency and decay time changes cannot be explained by spatially structured heating alone and instead point to a long-lived nonequilibrium spin-dependent electronic configuration. Within a phenomenological Elliott-Yafet framework, the simultaneous increase in FMR decay time and frequency is consistent with a transient reduction of the effective spin-mixing parameter governing spin-flip scattering. Our results demonstrate that the excitation pathway, rather than excitation energy alone, can serve as a control parameter for spin relaxation and provide access to nonequilibrium spin states that are not readily reached by conventional single-pulse excitation.

AI.tldr: 在非晶GdFeCo薄膜中，同步双飞秒脉冲激发可在特定窗口内显著延长类铁磁共振进动的寿命并小幅提高频率，表明激发路径本身可调控自旋弛豫并产生长寿命非平衡自旋态。
AI.motivation: 金属体系中光激发电子分布会通过快速电子-电子和电子-声子散射趋于准热化，难以长时间改变自旋相关相互作用；因此需要探索超越单纯热效应的光学自旋态控制途径。
AI.method: 采用对称双泵浦几何，使激发从单脉冲连续过渡到空间周期激发，从而分离空间激发图案效应与同步双脉冲激发效应；在非晶GdFeCo薄膜中测量相干磁化进动，并用时间窗口分析和唯象Elliott-Yafet框架解释结果。
AI.result: 发现一个窄激发窗口：类铁磁共振模式的寿命强烈增加，频率出现小幅但可重复的升高；增强寿命持续数百皮秒，明显长于周期激发图案相关的瞬态静磁效应。频率与衰减时间的同时变化不能仅由空间结构加热解释，而指向长寿命的非平衡自旋相关电子组态；在Elliott-Yafet框架下，这与自旋翻转散射的有效自旋混合参数瞬态降低一致。
AI.conclusion: 激发路径而非仅激发能量可作为自旋弛豫的控制参数，并能获得常规单脉冲激发难以达到的非平衡自旋态。

title: Instability-driven segregation of V group transition metals on HEB$_2$ grain boundaries influencing enhanced mechanical properties
summary: Five metals share a common sublattice in the (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B$_2$ (HEB$_2$). Most high-entropy materials are produced as polycrystalline materials in the form of sintered ceramics. The question of which metal species are located at grain boundaries is still unknown. Here, we calculated the grain-boundary energy $\gamma_{GB}$ of four types of boundaries in five binary diborides and HEB$_2$ using density functional theory (DFT). We analyzed the bonding at these boundaries using COHP and sampled cation segregation at six boundaries of HEB$_2$, ordered and general, using Monte Carlo / molecular dynamics with a MACE potential that was fine-tuned for this system. According to our results $\gamma_{GB}$ splits by group: the group V diborides NbB$_2$ and TaB$_2$ form boundaries with about half the energy of the group IV at three of the four types of GBs, ranging from 0.8 to 2.7 compared to 2.5--4.8~J/m$^2$. COHP shows a significant difference at the Fermi level, namely the Me--B bonds of NbB$_2$ and TaB$_2$ are antibonding at Fermi energy ($E_F$) in the bulk but bonding at the GB, while their integrated strength hardly changes. In HEB$_2$ the segregation follows a similar pattern: Nb and Ta are enriched at five of the six grain boundaries, including general boundaries, up to 23--35~at.\% at 2000~K, although the size of the atoms would favor Zr and Hf in the expanded sites. A segregated $\Sigma 193$ grain boundary can withstand 26 against 20~GPa for a random boundary in tension at 300~K. The grain boundaries of HEB$_2$ are composed of group V metals, as suggested by the boundary energies of binaries compounds and their bonding at the Fermi level. Grain boundaries of the (Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B$_2$ preferentially include Nb and Ta. This lowers the grain boundary energy and strengthens the boundaries. This consists of the lower boundary energy and changes Fermi level bonding in NbB$_2$ and TaB$_2$.

AI.tldr: 该文结合DFT、COHP与经微调的MACE势Monte Carlo/分子动力学，研究(Hf,Ta,Ti,Nb,Zr)B2高熵二硼化物及五种二元二硼化物的晶界能与阳离子偏析，发现Nb、Ta优先富集于晶界并降低晶界能、强化晶界。
AI.motivation: 高熵材料多为烧结多晶陶瓷，但晶界处具体由哪些金属占据仍不清楚；需要明确高熵二硼化物晶界的金属偏析行为及其对晶界能和力学性能的影响。
AI.method: 用DFT计算五种二元二硼化物和HEB2四类晶界的晶界能γ_GB，并用COHP分析晶界成键；针对HEB2的六个有序和一般晶界，采用为该体系微调的MACE势进行Monte Carlo/分子动力学采样以研究阳离子偏析，并评估偏析晶界的拉伸强度。
AI.result: γ_GB按族分裂：NbB2和TaB2等V族二硼化物在四类晶界中的三类上约为IV族的一半，为0.8–2.7 J/m2，而IV族为2.5–4.8 J/m2。COHP显示NbB2和TaB2中Me–B键在体相费米能级处为反键、在晶界处为成键，但积分键强变化很小。HEB2中Nb和Ta在六个晶界中的五个（包括一般晶界）富集，2000 K时可达23–35 at.%，尽管原子尺寸因素更利于Zr和Hf占据膨胀位点。偏析的Σ193晶界在300 K拉伸下可承受26 GPa，而随机晶界为20 GPa。
AI.conclusion: HEB2晶界倾向由V族金属尤其是Nb和Ta组成；Nb、Ta偏析降低晶界能并强化晶界，其机理包括更低的晶界能以及NbB2/TaB2中费米能级附近成键性质的改变。

title: NEP-kappa 2.0: A unified framework for phonon transport and nonequilibrium thermalization with machine-learning interatomic potentials
summary: We present NEP-kappa 2.0, a unified framework that integrates density-functional theory, material-specific machine-learning interatomic potentials, and pretrained force models for advanced phonon calculations. A common workflow enables harmonic lattice dynamics, quasi-harmonic and stochastic self-consistent phonon treatments, three- and four-phonon transport, Wigner population--coherence transport, and time-dependent phonon dynamics. Applications to 3C-SiC, BAs, and Cs$_2$AgInCl$_6$ demonstrate consistent force-model comparisons, finite-temperature renormalization, higher-order scattering, and intermode coherence. Beyond steady-state transport, mode-resolved simulations of selectively excited 3C-SiC reveal that half of the injected optical-phonon energy reaches acoustic modes within approximately 3.75 ps, primarily through one-optical--two-acoustic scattering. Acoustic branches exhibit response times differing by a factor of five, with competing scattering channels producing a transient energy overshoot. Channel-resolved entropy production and persistent nonthermal occupations distinguish interbranch energy redistribution from intrabranch thermalization. The framework connects equilibrium phonon transport with microscopic nonequilibrium energy dynamics.

AI.tldr: NEP-kappa 2.0 是一个统一声子计算框架，整合 DFT、材料专用机器学习势和预训练力模型，覆盖从简谐/准简谐声子、三/四声子输运、Wigner 相干输运到时变声子动力学，并用于研究平衡输运与微观非平衡能量动力学。
AI.motivation: 先进声子计算需要兼顾第一性原理精度、机器学习势效率、高阶散射与相干效应，并能统一描述平衡态输运和非平衡态能量重分布。
AI.method: 构建通用工作流，集成密度泛函理论、材料特异性机器学习原子间势和预训练力模型；支持简谐晶格动力学、准简谐与随机自洽声子、三声子和四声子输运、Wigner 布居-相干输运以及含时声子动力学；在 3C-SiC、BAs 和 Cs2AgInCl6 上验证力模型比较、有限温重整化、高阶散射和模间相干。
AI.result: 在选择性激发 3C-SiC 的模分辨模拟中，约 3.75 ps 内一半注入光学声子能量到达声学模，主要通过单光学-双声学散射；不同声学支响应时间相差约 5 倍，竞争散射通道导致瞬态能量过冲；通道分辨熵产生和持续非热占据可区分支间能量重分布与支内热化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将平衡声子输运与微观非平衡能量动力学联系起来，为高阶散射、相干输运和时域声子能量弛豫提供统一计算平台。

title: Microscopic Compensation of Circular Optical Response in Altermagnets
summary: A weak or vanishing circular optical signal need not imply weak helicity-sensitive transitions: it can be the residual of much larger opposing microscopic contributions. We resolve the finite-frequency interband Kubo response before summing over transitions and momentum, separating cancellation among transitions at fixed momentum from cancellation across the Brillouin zone. An exactly compensated $d$-wave model establishes the symmetry benchmark. In MnTe, first-principles Wannier calculations reveal a symmetry-dark N\'eel orientation with an extended sign-changing circular kernel whose bulk integral vanishes. Reorienting the N\'eel vector removes this extinction, yet the allowed response remains a small imbalance between large positive- and negative-momentum sectors; the imbalance reverses with photon energy and flips the macroscopic sign. Thus magnetic symmetry decides whether circular response is allowed, whereas microscopic compensation determines how much survives and with what sign. This distinction provides a general framework for interpreting weak, vanishing, and sign-changing magneto-optical signals in compensated magnets.

AI.tldr: 弱或消失的圆偏振光学信号并不一定意味着螺旋敏感跃迁弱，而可能是大量相反微观贡献相消后的残余。该工作通过在跃迁和动量求和前解析有限频率带间Kubo响应，区分固定动量下跃迁间的抵消与布里渊区间的抵消，并在MnTe中揭示磁对称性决定响应是否允许、微观补偿决定残余大小和符号。
AI.motivation: 圆光响应弱或为零常被直接解释为螺旋敏感跃迁弱，但实际上可能源于大而相反的微观贡献相互抵消。需要区分宏观信号缺失是由对称性禁戒造成，还是由微观补偿造成，从而正确解释补偿磁体中的弱、消失和变号磁光信号。
AI.method: 在對跃迁和动量求和之前解析有限频率带间Kubo响应，将同一动量处不同跃迁间的抵消与整个布里渊区不同动量间的抵消分开；用精确补偿的d波模型建立对称性基准；对MnTe进行第一性原理Wannier计算，分析圆响应核的动量分辨结构。
AI.result: 精确补偿d波模型给出完全抵消的对称性基准。MnTe中存在对称暗的Néel取向，其扩展的圆响应核符号变化且布里渊区积分消失；重新取向Néel矢量可解除消光，但允许的响应仍是大正、负动量扇区之间的小不平衡，该不平衡随光子能量反转并导致宏观符号翻转。
AI.conclusion: 磁对称性决定圆光响应是否被允许，而微观补偿决定最终存活多少响应及其符号。该区分提供了解释补偿磁体中弱、消失和变号磁光信号的通用框架。

title: Autonomous adaptive spectral analysis with an LLM agent for self-driving laboratories
summary: Self-driving laboratories accelerate materials exploration through autonomous closed-loop integration of synthesis, characterization, and next-experiment selection. However, characterization does not always directly provide the target property; measured spectra or images often require automated analysis to extract quantitative descriptors based on physically motivated assumptions and predefined criteria. Such procedures can fail for measurements outside these criteria, requiring a decision on whether a reliable value can be recovered or no numerical value should be reported. Here, we implemented an autonomous adaptive spectral-analysis agent using a large language model (LLM) to supervise a deterministic numerical-analysis routine. For each spectrum, the agent executes the predefined analysis script and assesses the result using the measured spectrum and fitting diagnostics. Valid results are accepted unchanged, recoverable failures are reanalyzed through bounded adjustments of predefined fitting parameters, and NaN (not a number) is returned when no scientifically defensible value can be obtained. We evaluated the workflow on optical transmittance spectra from 203 epitaxial beta-Ga2O3 films grown during a previously reported self-driving thin-film growth campaign. The predefined optical analysis script returned Urbach energy, an optical-quality metric, for 183 spectra and failed for 20. The agent retained those 183 values and evaluated 20 exception cases, recovering 16 through bounded parameter adjustments and returning NaN for 4 when the spectral evidence did not support a reliable Urbach tail. The audit records captured spectral features, parameter changes, and rationale for each decision. These results demonstrate autonomous scientific exception handling by an LLM agent while leaving quantitative property extraction to deterministic numerical analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究用LLM智能体监督确定性的光谱数值分析流程，实现自驱动实验室中的自主异常处理：在203个β-Ga2O3外延膜透射光谱中，保留183个有效Urbach能量结果，对20个失败案例恢复16个，并对4个证据不足案例返回NaN。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室需要自动从光谱或图像中提取定量性质，但固定分析脚本基于物理假设和预设标准，面对超出标准的测量可能失败；此时需判断能否可靠恢复数值，还是应报告无可靠数值。
AI.method: 构建由LLM监督预定义数值分析脚本的自适应光谱分析智能体。对每个光谱执行脚本，并结合实测光谱与拟合诊断评估结果：有效结果原样接受；可恢复失败通过有界调整预定义拟合参数重新分析；无法获得科学上可辩护数值时返回NaN；同时记录审计信息。
AI.result: 在先前自驱动薄膜生长 campaign 的203个β-Ga2O3外延膜光学透射光谱上评估：预定义脚本对183个光谱返回Urbach能量、对20个失败。智能体保留183个值，评估20个异常案例，通过有界参数调整恢复16个，对4个返回NaN；审计记录包含光谱特征、参数变化和决策理由。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明LLM智能体可自主处理科学分析中的异常，同时将定量性质提取交由确定性数值分析完成，并保持决策可审计。

title: Crystal Structure Based Graph Neural Network And LLM Multi-Modal Approach for Material Magnetic Ordering Prediction
summary: AI/ML models are useful for the prediction of materials' properties. Recently, there has been great progress in developing Neural Network models to predict the properties of solids, molecules, and crystals, avoiding expensive and time-consuming laboratory testing. This study presents a novel AI/ML-based multi-modal approach to predict material magnetic ordering using material crystal structure information as input to a Graph Neural Network model (GNN) and semantic text descriptions of the material's properties and structure as input to a Large Language Model (LLM), before performing information fusion of the GNN and LLM outputs to predict material magnetic ordering in four classes (Non-magnetic, Ferromagnetic, Antiferromagnetic, Ferrimagnetic). The model is trained, validated, and tested on a dataset which is a combination of Materials Project dataset, Magndata dataset, and a set of uranium compounds with magnetic ordering determined in laboratory testing, with an 80/10/10 (training/validation/testing) data split. The proposed GNN and LLM multi-modal approach achieves better overall accuracy than both the standalone GNN and LLM approaches with three fusion strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）与大语言模型（LLM）的多模态AI/ML方法，融合晶体结构信息与材料性质/结构的语义文本描述，用于预测材料磁有序类别。
AI.motivation: AI/ML可避免昂贵耗时的实验测试并预测材料性质；研究旨在利用多模态信息提升材料磁有序预测性能，并比较其与单独GNN或LLM模型的效果。
AI.method: 以材料晶体结构作为GNN输入，以材料性质与结构的语义文本描述作为LLM输入；对GNN和LLM输出进行信息融合，预测非磁、铁磁、反铁磁和亚铁磁四类磁有序。数据由Materials Project、Magndata及一组经实验室测定磁有序的铀化合物组合而成，按80/10/10划分训练/验证/测试集，并采用三种融合策略。
AI.result: 所提出的GNN与LLM多模态方法在三种融合策略下，整体准确率均优于单独的GNN方法和单独的LLM方法。
AI.conclusion: 多模态GNN-LLM信息融合能有效提升材料磁有序预测性能，表明结合晶体结构与语义文本信息在材料磁性预测中具有潜力。

title: A Stress-Induced Tetragonal Distortion in K2OsCl6 under Pressure
summary: The structural behaviour of cubic (Fm-3m) K2OsCl6 under compression was investigated to 35.4 GPa using angle-dispersive synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction. Upon increasing pressure, K2OsCl6 undergoes a sequence of structural transformations from the ambient-pressure cubic phase to a tetragonal (P4/mnc) phase above 9.5(3) GPa, followed by a transition to a monoclinic (P21/n) phase beginning at approximately 14.2 GPa. The tetragonal and monoclinic phases coexist over the pressure range 14.2-17.2 GPa, while the monoclinic phase is observed as the sole phase at 17.9 GPa and remains stable up to the maximum pressure investigated. Analysis of the diffraction profiles and unit-cell parameters indicates that the intermediate tetragonal structure is likely associated with stress-induced symmetry lowering rather than a distinct thermodynamic phase. This distortion, which is adequately described by the tetragonal P4/mnc space group, is attributed to non-hydrostatic deviatoric stresses arising from the pressure-transmitting medium. Equation-of-state analysis reveals a pronounced reduction in compressibility across the structural transitions, with the bulk modulus increasing from 26(2) GPa for the cubic phase to 71(3) GPa for the monoclinic phase. The pressure-induced structural sequence is analogous to that reported for related compounds such as K2IrCl6, although the transitions in K2OsCl6 occur at lower pressures. All structural transformations are reversible upon decompression.

AI.tldr: 在至35.4 GPa的压缩下，K2OsCl6由立方相经四方相转变为单斜相，中间四方相可能源于非静水应力导致的对称性降低，结构转变可逆且体模量显著增大。
AI.motivation: 研究立方相K2OsCl6的高压结构稳定性、相变序列与压缩性，并与K2IrCl6等相关化合物比较，理解压力及非静水应力对结构行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用角度色散同步辐射粉末X射线衍射，在最高35.4 GPa压力范围内测量K2OsCl6的衍射谱和晶胞参数，并进行结构精修与状态方程分析。
AI.result: 立方Fm-3m相在9.5(3) GPa以上转变为四方P4/mnc相，约14.2 GPa开始转变为单斜P21/n相；两相在14.2–17.2 GPa共存，17.9 GPa时单斜相为唯一相并稳定至最高压力。四方中间相可能由压力 transmitting medium 引起的非静水偏应力导致，而非独立热力学相。体模量由立方相的26(2) GPa增至单斜相的71(3) GPa，结构转变序列类似K2IrCl6但压力更低，且所有转变在卸压后可逆。
AI.conclusion: K2OsCl6在压缩下发生立方—四方—单斜的结构演化，结构转变伴随压缩性显著降低；其中四方相更可能是应力诱导的对称性降低，相关相变具有可逆性。

title: Interfacial origin of magnetic compensation and topological-like Hall effect in crystalline lutetium iron garnet thin films.
summary: Ferrimagnetic oxides such as rare-earth iron garnets (REIG) have emerged as essential components of spin-based devices owing to their high Curie temperatures, low Gilbert damping, and excellent insulating properties. Recently, REIGs have attracted immense interest for hosting robust chiral spin textures that can be potential information carriers in next-generation spintronic devices. Here we investigate the structural, chemical, and magnetic behaviour of single-crystal Lu3Fe5O12 (LuIG) thin films for different film thicknesses on a Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111) or SGGG(111) substrate. Our results demonstrate the presence of a 3 nm-thick Gd-rich LuIG layer at the LuIG/SGGG interface, which gives rise to a magnetic compensation temperature around 50 K. We further probe the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in LuIG layers with an adjacent platinum ultrathin film. In addition to the magnetic compensation point, the AHE loops show pronounced nonmonotonic features, often attributed to the spin Hall topological-like Hall effect (SH-THE) and non-collinear spin textures arising from the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI). LuIG thickness-dependent AHE measurements reveal that the composition variation due to Gd diffusion breaks the inversion symmetry and could contribute to DMI. These findings shed light on fundamental understanding and engineering of the different interfaces of magnetic garnets for advanced spintronic device applications.

AI.tldr: 研究了不同厚度Lu3Fe5O12(LuIG)单晶薄膜在SGGG(111)衬底上的结构、化学与磁性，发现界面处约3 nm富Gd LuIG层导致约50 K磁补偿温度，并在LuIG/Pt体系中观察到与补偿点和DMI相关非共线自旋织构有关的异常霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 稀土铁石榴石等亚铁磁氧化物因高居里温度、低Gilbert阻尼和绝缘性而适用于自旋电子器件；其中稳定手性自旋织构可作为下一代信息载体，因此需理解LuIG薄膜及界面对其磁性和输运行为的影响。
AI.method: 在Gd3(Mg,Zr)Ga5O12(111)（SGGG）衬底上生长不同厚度的LuIG单晶薄膜，表征其结构、化学和磁性；并在LuIG上覆盖超薄Pt层测量异常霍尔效应(AHE)，结合LuIG厚度依赖的AHE分析界面扩散与DMI效应。
AI.result: 发现LuIG/SGGG界面存在约3 nm厚富Gd LuIG层，产生约50 K的磁补偿温度；LuIG/Pt的AHE回线除补偿点外还表现出显著非单调特征，常归因于自旋霍尔类拓扑霍尔效应(SH-THE)和DMI诱导的非共线自旋织构；厚度依赖测量表明Gd扩散引起的成分变化破坏反演对称性并可贡献DMI。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了磁性石榴石界面成分扩散对磁补偿、AHE及DMI相关自旋织构的重要影响，为先进自旋电子器件中磁性石榴石界面的基础理解和工程调控提供了依据。

title: Magnetoelectric Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Solids
summary: It is commonly believed that a bulk photovoltaic current requires broken spatial inversion symmetry. However, in this work, we demonstrate that dc photocurrents can arise in centrosymmetric solids from the bilinear coupling between the electric and magnetic components of light. This magnetoelectric bulk photovoltaic effect (MBPE) has a quantum-geometric origin in the dipole moments of the Zeeman quantum metric and Zeeman Berry curvature. We identify four distinct MBPE mechanisms, including time-reversal-even and time-reversal-odd injection-like and shift-like photocurrents driven by linearly or circularly polarized light. Our symmetry analysis shows that the MBPE is allowed in broad classes of two-dimensional centrosymmetric nonmagnetic and magnetic materials under normally incident light. As representative examples, we predict sizable MBPEs in centrosymmetric monolayer Pt$_2$HgSe$_3$ and altermagnetic RuF$_4$, with current densities on the order of $1~\mathrm{mA/m}$. Notably, the injection-like photocurrent in RuF$_4$ reverses sign upon switching either the light helicity or the N\'eel vector. Our results extend the bulk photovoltaic effect to centrosymmetric solids and open new opportunities for electrical readout of altermagnetic order.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并证明中心对称固体中也可产生直流光电流：由光电场与磁场分量的双线性耦合驱动，称为磁电体光伏效应（MBPE），其起源为Zeeman量子度规与Zeeman贝里曲率的偶极矩。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为体光伏电流需要空间反演对称性破缺；作者希望突破这一限制，将体光伏效应拓展到中心对称非磁性与磁性材料，并探索用于交错磁序电学读出的新机制。
AI.method: 通过量子几何理论识别出四种MBPE机制，包括时间反演偶/奇、注入型/位移型光电流，并分析线偏振与圆偏振光驱动情形；结合对称性分析筛选二维中心对称非磁性和磁性材料，并以单层Pt2HgSe3与交错磁RuF4为代表性体系进行第一性原理预测。
AI.result: MBPE在正常入射光下可存在于广泛二维中心对称材料中；在Pt2HgSe3和RuF4中预测出约1 mA/m量级的可观光电流。RuF4中的注入型光电流在切换光螺旋度或Néel矢量时反号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将体光伏效应推广至中心对称固体，揭示了磁电耦合与量子几何起源的新光伏机制，并为交错磁序的全电学读出提供了可能。

title: Nanowire-Assisted Epitaxial Lateral Overgrowth of Planar GaN(0001) on Diamond(100)
summary: GaN-on-diamond heterostructures are promising for high-power and high-frequency electronics, however, direct epi- taxial growth on diamond (100) remains challenging due to severe lattice and thermal mismatches, which induce high threading dislocation densities. To overcome this challenge, we have used Plasma Assisted Molecular Beam Epitaxy (PAMBE) to grow wurtzite GaN layers on diamond(100) substrates using nanowire-assisted epitaxial lateral overgrowth (ELOG). Two nanowire templates (NW100, NW600) were benchmarked against a nanowire-free reference (NW000). High-resolution XRD, {\phi} -scans, (0002) pole figures, and reciprocal space mapping show that NW100 attains the lowest dislocation density (5.51 x 10-4 nm-2) and microstrain (2.736 x 10-3), the narrowest (0002) reflection, and a c-axis lattice parameter (5.1821 {\AA}) within 0.06% of the bulk value; NW000, in contrast, exhibits a contracted c-axis (5.1633 {\AA}) and elevated dislocation density (6.26 x 10-4 nm-2), consistent with residual tensile stress. Cross-sectional TEM con- firms the intended diamond/AlN/nanowire/ELOG/planar-GaN layer sequence and shows threading dislocations bending into near-lateral trajectories, directly evidencing defect filtering by the nanowire template. Together, these results estab- lish nanowire-assisted ELOG as an effective strategy to suppress dislocation propagation and recover near-bulk lattice parameters in GaN-on-diamond heteroepitaxy, providing a structurally well-defined platform for device integration.

AI.tldr: 该文报道在金刚石(100)衬底上采用等离子体辅助分子束外延(PAMBE)与纳米线辅助外延横向过生长(ELOG)制备GaN-on-diamond异质结构，并通过对比不同纳米线模板证明其可显著降低位错密度、微应变并恢复近体材料晶格参数。
AI.motivation: GaN-on-diamond异质结构适用于高功率和高频电子器件，但GaN在金刚石(100)上直接外延受严重晶格失配和热失配限制，导致高位错密度，因此需要有效抑制穿透位错传播的外延策略。
AI.method: 采用PAMBE在金刚石(100)上生长纤锌矿GaN层，并使用纳米线辅助ELOG；设置NW100、NW600两种纳米线模板与无纳米线参考样NW000进行基准对比。表征手段包括高分辨XRD、φ扫描、(0002)极图、倒易空间映射(RSM)以及截面TEM。
AI.result: NW100获得最低位错密度(5.51×10^-4 nm^-2)和微应变(2.736×10^-3)，(0002)反射最窄，c轴晶格参数为5.1821 Å，与体材料值偏差在0.06%以内；NW000则表现为c轴收缩(5.1633 Å)和更高位错密度(6.26×10^-4 nm^-2)，与残余张应力一致。截面TEM确认了金刚石/AlN/纳米线/ELOG/平面GaN的层序，并显示穿透位错弯曲为近横向轨迹，直接证明纳米线模板的缺陷过滤作用。
AI.conclusion: 纳米线辅助ELOG是抑制GaN-on-diamond异质外延中位错传播并恢复近体材料晶格参数的有效策略，可为器件集成提供结构明确的外延平台。

title: Hidden piezo-Hall effect
summary: Extensive studies of hidden spin polarization have established a broad class of hidden phenomena in quantum materials. Here, we introduce the hidden piezo-Hall effect, in which strain induces finite anomalous Hall conductivities (AHCs) in individual sectors while the global AHC remains zero. At zero strain, neither the full system nor its sectors exhibit an anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Under uniaxial strain, however, opposite sector AHCs emerge while their sum remains canceled. We establish this effect for a $d$-wave hidden altermagnet using a tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for the experimentally synthesized material $\mathrm{RbV_2Te_2O}$. Rotating the strain direction from the $x$ to the $y$ axis reverses the signs of the sector AHCs without generating a net Hall response. The same symmetry mechanism may also give rise to hidden piezomagneto-optical, piezo-thermal Hall, piezo-Nernst, and piezo-Ettingshausen effects. Our work extends hidden physics to strain-controlled transport and identifies $\mathrm{RbV_2Te_2O}$ as a promising candidate for experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 提出隐藏压电霍尔效应：单轴应变可在子体系中诱导有限且符号相反的反常霍尔电导（AHC），但全局AHC保持为零；在d波隐藏交错磁体RbV2Te2O中验证。
AI.motivation: 将隐藏物理从隐藏自旋极化拓展到应变调控的电荷输运，寻找整体无反常霍尔效应但子体系具有可观测响应的量子材料。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚模型并结合第一性原理计算，研究d波隐藏交错磁体RbV2Te2O在单轴应变及应变方向旋转下的子体系AHC与全局AHC。
AI.result: 零应变时全系统和子体系均无AHE；单轴应变下子体系出现等大反号的AHC且总和抵消；将应变方向从x轴转到y轴会使子体系AHC符号反转但不产生净霍尔响应；同一对称性机制还可导致隐藏压磁光、压热霍尔、压能斯特和压埃廷斯豪森效应。
AI.conclusion: 建立了隐藏压电霍尔效应，将隐藏物理扩展到应变控制的输运现象，并指出RbV2Te2O是实验验证的有前景候选材料。

title: Machine Learning-Assisted Discovery of Carbon-Related Defect Formation Mechanisms in Diamond
summary: Diamond is an important host material for functional defects such as solid-state spin qubits. During the defect creation by irradiation and subsequent thermal annealing, carbon-related defects, including vacancies and interstitials, are generated and can migrate to form new defect complexes. To investigate this kinetically driven process and reveal the formation mechanisms of the di-interstitials and di-vacancies in the neutral charge state, we fine-tuned a universal machine learning interatomic potential using a small dataset generated from density functional theory calculations. We obtained a barrier of 1.84 eV for mono-interstitial migration and found that two initially separated mono-interstitials only need to overcome a lower barrier to form di-interstitial configurations. Beyond the training data, the MLIP also identified the formation pathway for an additional di-interstitial configuration and a stepwise divacancy dissociation mechanism. These results reveal migration-assisted defect complex formation mechanisms and demonstrate how targeted MLIP training can identify reaction pathways.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过精细训练机器学习原子间势（MLIP），研究金刚石中中性间隙与空位缺陷的迁移及二聚体形成/解离机制。
AI.motivation: 金刚石中的固态自旋量子比特等功能缺陷在辐照和退火过程中会伴随碳相关缺陷（空位、间隙）迁移并形成新缺陷复合物，需揭示二间隙和二空位的动力学形成机制。
AI.method: 基于少量密度泛函理论（DFT）数据微调通用机器学习原子间势，用其模拟中性电荷态下间隙迁移、二间隙形成及二空位解离的反应路径与势垒。
AI.result: 得到单间隙迁移势垒为1.84 eV；两个初始分离的单间隙形成二间隙构型需克服更低势垒；MLIP还超出训练数据识别出另一种二间隙形成路径及逐步式二空位解离机制。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了迁移辅助的缺陷复合物形成机制，并表明有针对性的MLIP训练可有效识别反应路径。

title: La14.33(CN3)8N, a Nitridocarbonate based on the (CN3)5- Ion
summary: Metal nitridocarbonates containing the (NCN)2- ion are established for a multitude of metal atoms throughout the periodic table. The preparation of nitridocarbonate compounds containing a (CN3)5-, (C2N4)6-, or (C3N6)6- ion remains challenging, although corresponding species have been established. The new compound La14.33(CN3)8N was synthesized in a conventional solid-state metathesis reaction from a mixture of LaF3, Na2(CN2) and Li3N in an open system at 550 {\deg}C. The reaction conditions, including the formation and de-composition of La14.33(CN3)8N are analyzed on basis of thermoanalytic studies. The crystal structure of La14.33(CN3)8N was refined by single-crystal X-ray diffraction, and the mid-IR frequencies resulting from two crystallographically distinct (CN3)5- ions in the structure are reported. 23Na, 7Li and 13C NMR studies provide additional support for the identity of the compound. The crystal structure of La14.33(CN3)8N is isotypic to that of Ce15(BN3)8N.

AI.tldr: 通过固态复分解法合成并表征了首个含(CN3)5-离子的镧系氮碳化合物La14.33(CN3)8N，确证其结构与阴离子身份。
AI.motivation: 金属氮碳化合物中(NCN)2-已被广泛研究，但含(CN3)5-、(C2N4)6-或(C3N6)6-的类似化合物制备仍具挑战性，相关物种和结构信息有限。
AI.method: 在开放体系中于550 °C下，以LaF3、Na2(CN2)和Li3N混合物进行常规固态复分解反应合成La14.33(CN3)8N；结合热分析研究反应条件及形成/分解行为；利用单晶X射线衍射精修晶体结构，并采用中红外光谱、23Na/7Li/13C NMR进行表征。
AI.result: 成功获得La14.33(CN3)8N；单晶XRD显示其结构与Ce15(BN3)8N同型；中红外光谱观察到结构中两个晶体学独立的(CN3)5-离子所产生的振动频率；23Na、7Li和13C NMR结果进一步支持该化合物的身份。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓展了含(CN3)5-离子的金属氮碳化合物体系，表明通过固态复分解路线可获得此前难以制备的氮碳阴离子物种，并为该类化合物的结构与谱学表征提供依据。

title: Investigating relative population partitioning in the presence of B$^-_\text{C}$ defects in diamond
summary: Leveraging our earlier formalism for charge-state decay [see R. Kuate Defo et al., 108 235208 (2023)], we investigate relative population partitioning in the presence of singly negatively charged substitutional boron impurities (B$^-_{\rm C}$) in diamond samples, where these diamond samples also contain substitutional nitrogen (N$_{\rm C }$) impurities and have ether-terminated surfaces. Effectively, given any two defects, one donor and one acceptor, such that their charge-transition levels, their relative populations, and the temperature are known, the timescale for charge transfer between the two defects is completely determined. We use this insight and experimental measurements for the timescale for charge transfer between NV$^-$ centers and N$_{\rm C}$ hybridized with the ether-terminated surface of diamond, as well as the temperature and the relative populations for the NV$^-$ centers, [see Z. Yuan et al., Phys. Rev. Res. 2, 033263 (2020)] to argue that an additional defect must be modulating the relative populations of N$_{\rm C}$ hybridized with the ether-terminated surface of diamond. The shifts in the local Fermi level for N$_{\rm C}$ hybridized with the ether-terminated surface of diamond are consistent with the additional defect being a substitutional boron impurity (B$_{\rm C}$). Ultimately, our results allow for the determination of local relative concentrations of ionized defects.

AI.tldr: 基于电荷态衰减形式化，研究含B$^-_{\rm C}$、N$_{\rm C}$及醚端接表面金刚石中的相对布居分配，论证额外缺陷调控N$_{\rm C}$布居，并以B$_{\rm C}$解释局域费米能级移动，从而可确定电离缺陷的局域相对浓度。
AI.motivation: 理解金刚石中杂质、NV$^-$色心与表面态共存时的电荷转移和相对布居分配，特别是识别影响醚端接表面杂化N$_{\rm C}$布居的额外缺陷，并定量局域电离缺陷浓度。
AI.method: 采用先前提出的电荷态衰变形式化：已知供体/受体的电荷跃迁能级、相对布居和温度，即可确定电荷转移时间尺度；结合NV$^-$与醚端接表面杂化N$_{\rm C}$之间电荷转移时间尺度、温度及NV$^-$相对布居的实验数据，分析N$_{\rm C}$局域费米能级移动并检验额外缺陷假设。
AI.result: 实验数据表明仅已知缺陷不足以解释杂化N$_{\rm C}$体系的相对布居，必须有额外缺陷调制；其局域费米能级移动与替位硼杂质B$_{\rm C}$一致，且B$^-_{\rm C}$参与相对布居分配。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可识别调控电荷态布居的额外缺陷，并最终用于确定金刚石中电离缺陷的局域相对浓度。

title: Atomic-level study of dose-dependent lattice thermal conductivity degradation in irradiated tungsten
summary: Plasma-facing components (PFCs) in future fusion reactors must withstand extreme environments, making tungsten (W) a prime candidate material due to its high thermal conductivity, high melting temperature, low sputtering yield, low tritium absorption. However, neutron irradiation introduces complex nanostructural defects that severely degrade these critical properties. In this work, we use Non-Equilibrium Molecular Dynamics (NEMD) simulations coupled with the Creation Relaxation Algorithm (CRA) to investigate the lattice thermal conductivity (kappa) of W across a wide range of irradiation doses. Systems treated with different doses up to 1.8 canonical displacements per atom (cdpa) were simulated to generate and study diverse defect structures, including vacancies and self-interstitial atom (SIA) clusters. By correlating spatially-resolved temperature gradients with local defect concentrations, we show that even small changes in defect type and distribution significantly affect thermal transport. We employ Machine Learning (ML) models to develop a quantitative relationship between the defect features and the resulting thermal conductivity degradation. The ML analysis identifies vacancy density as the dominant structural factor controlling thermal transport. We found a significant, nonlinear suppression of kappa with increasing defect density. Predictive multi-defect mapping built upon our ML model resolved a step-like degradation transition at a critical vacancy threshold of 0.05 at.%, beyond which phonon scattering completely saturated and capped the maximum relative lattice thermal conductivity degradation at approximately 30 at.%. This integrated simulation and ML approach provides a powerful, predictive framework for quantifying the complex relationship between structure and thermal conductivity in irradiated fusion materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）、Creation Relaxation Algorithm（CRA）和机器学习，研究中子辐照钨中缺陷类型与分布对晶格热导率的影响，发现空位密度是主导因素，并在0.05 at.%空位阈值处出现阶梯式热导率退化。
AI.motivation: 未来聚变堆等离子体面向部件（PFCs）面临极端环境，钨因高热导率、高熔点、低溅射产额和低氚吸收成为候选材料，但中子辐照引入的复杂纳米结构缺陷会严重降低其关键热物理性能，因此需要定量理解辐照缺陷与热导率退化之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用NEMD耦合CRA模拟不同辐照剂量下钨的缺陷结构，剂量最高达1.8 canonical displacements per atom（cdpa），生成并研究空位和自间隙原子（SIA）团簇等缺陷；将空间分辨温度梯度与局部缺陷浓度关联，并利用机器学习模型建立缺陷特征与晶格热导率退化之间的定量映射。
AI.result: 缺陷类型和分布的微小变化即可显著影响热输运；机器学习分析表明空位密度是控制热输运的主导结构因素；晶格热导率随缺陷密度增加呈显著非线性抑制；多缺陷预测映射揭示在0.05 at.%临界空位阈值处出现阶梯式退化转变，超过该阈值后声子散射完全饱和，最大相对晶格热导率退化被限制在约30 at.%。
AI.conclusion: 该集成模拟与机器学习方法为量化辐照聚变材料中复杂结构—热导率关系提供了强有力的预测框架。

title: Vacancy and Helium-Cluster Thermomigration in Tungsten
summary: Strong thermal gradients in tungsten plasma-facing components can bias the migration of irradiation-induced defects and thereby alter their redistribution, interaction, and retention. Here, we extend an atomistic jump-statistics framework previously developed for hydrogen to quantify the thermomigration of a single vacancy and interstitial He$_1$--He$_4$ clusters in body-centered-cubic tungsten. Non-equilibrium molecular-dynamics simulations performed over several thermal gradients are used to determine the directional jump ratio, while geometrically derived projected jump lengths convert the fitted directional-bias coefficient into the heat-of-transport coefficient $Q^*=\alpha kT^2$, where $k$ is the Boltzmann constant, $T$ the temperature, and $\alpha$ a constant. All investigated defects exhibit negative values of $\alpha$, corresponding to net migration toward the hot region. He$_4$ has the largest response, $\alpha=-2.2457\times10^{-2}$ K$^{-1}$, followed closely by the vacancy, whereas He$_3$ exhibits the weakest response despite its intermediate cluster size. Independent constant-temperature simulations over 1000--1600 K show that He$_3$ is also the least mobile cluster and has the largest effective migration energy, $E_m^{\mathrm{eff}}=0.271$ eV. In contrast, He$_4$ is more mobile than He$_3$ and has the smallest effective migration energy, 0.087 eV. Agreement between the He$_3$ concentration profile predicted from the jump statistics and that obtained from a long molecular-dynamics trajectory provides an independent validation of the method. These results show that thermomigration cannot be inferred from cluster size, diffusivity, or migration energy alone and provide defect-specific heat-of-transport parameters for higher-length-scale models of tungsten under fusion-relevant thermal gradients.

AI.tldr: 该研究将原子尺度跳跃统计框架扩展到bcc钨中的单空位和He$_1$--He$_4$间隙团簇，量化热梯度驱动的热迁移，并给出缺陷特异性热输运系数$Q^*=\alpha kT^2$。
AI.motivation: 钨面向等离子体部件中的强热梯度会偏置辐照诱导缺陷的迁移，改变其再分布、相互作用和滞留；需要定量描述单空位与He团簇的热迁移行为，为更高尺度模型提供参数。
AI.method: 基于非平衡分子动力学在多个热梯度下计算定向跳跃比；用几何推导的投影跳跃长度将拟合的定向偏置系数转化为热输运系数$Q^*=\alpha kT^2$；并在1000--1600 K进行恒温模拟以评估迁移率与有效迁移能，同时用长MD轨迹得到的He$_3$浓度剖面验证跳跃统计方法。
AI.result: 所有研究缺陷的$\alpha$均为负，表示净迁移朝向热区。He$_4$响应最大，$\alpha=-2.2457\times10^{-2}$ K$^{-1}$，空位次之；He$_3$响应最弱，尽管其团簇尺寸居中。恒温模拟显示He$_3$迁移率最低且有效迁移能最大，$E_m^{\mathrm{eff}}=0.271$ eV；He$_4$比He$_3$更易迁移且有效迁移能最小，为0.087 eV。跳跃统计预测的He$_3$浓度剖面与长MD轨迹结果一致，提供了独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 热迁移不能仅由团簇尺寸、扩散率或迁移能推断；该工作提供了聚变相关热梯度下钨中缺陷特异的热输运参数，可支撑更高长度尺度模型。

title: Monolayer van der Waals kagome lattice for high-temperature flat-band physics
summary: Kagome lattice materials host a remarkably rich landscape of novel quantum phenomena, all arising from the intrinsic interplay of topology, correlation, and frustration. While previous studies have been mostly limited to bulk three-dimensional (3D) kagome crystals, the realization of a true two-dimensional (2D) kagome system has remained a long-standing goal, to unlock fundamentally new physics and engineering pathways inaccessible in 3D systems. In this work, we establish the first ideal 2D monolayer kagome lattices by leveraging a novel and versatile van der Waals (vdW) kagome family, A2T3X4 (A = K, Rb, Cs; T = Ni, Pd, Pt; X = S, Se). Our nano-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (nano-ARPES) directly characterizes the electronic structure of A2T3X4 down to the monolayer limit, notably revealing an isolated kagome-derived flat band just below the Fermi level. Via gate-engineering of 2D A2T3X4, the kagome flat band can be further tuned to the Fermi level, allowing direct access to the partially filled flat band physics and establishing a qualitatively new 2D flat band platform. Compared to existing moire-based artificial flat band systems, this vdW kagome-based intrinsic flat band system realizes more than 220 times higher flat band electron density, opening an entirely new density and energy regime for exploring 2D flat band physics. Harnessing this high-electron-density flat band in 2D vdW kagome system provides a clear pathway to scale emergent flat band phenomena - such as fractional quantum anomalous Hall states - to far higher temperatures than currently achievable, as long-envisioned in theory and further supported by our many-body calculations.

AI.tldr: 该工作首次实现理想二维单层Kagome晶格，并直接观测到近费米面的孤立Kagome平带，通过栅压调控将其调至费米面，建立高电子密度的本征二维平带平台。
AI.motivation: 此前Kagome研究多局限于三维体材料，真正二维Kagome体系长期缺失；实现二维单层Kagome有望解锁三维体系无法获得的新物理与调控路径。
AI.method: 利用范德华Kagome家族A2T3X4（A=K,Rb,Cs；T=Ni,Pd,Pt；X=S,Se），结合纳米聚焦角分辨光电子能谱表征至单层极限的电子结构，并通过栅压工程调控平带位置，辅以多体计算。
AI.result: 获得首个理想二维单层Kagome晶格；nano-ARPES显示费米能级下方存在孤立Kagome衍生平带；栅压可将其调至费米能级以研究部分填充平带物理；其平带电子密度比现有moire人工平带体系高220倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该范德华Kagome本征平带体系开辟了二维平带物理的新密度与能量区间，为将分数量子反常霍尔等平带涌现现象推广至更高温度提供了可行路径。

title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and deconfined criticality in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$
summary: SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ is the leading candidate for deconfined criticality, yet theories of its critical regime omit the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions, which gap the kagome Dirac spin liquid. Adding them to the SU(2) gauge theory, we show that time reversal and a spin-orbit-locked glide forbid any gauge-singlet spinon mass to all orders. In-plane DM only twists the spinons, reconstructing the nodes below $0.03$-$0.17$ K, while out-of-plane DM is irrelevant and SO(5) anisotropy arises only at second order. The material thus remains a platform for deconfined criticality, which NMR can test, since a $[100]$ field induces a N\'eel moment and a $[001]$ field does not.

AI.tldr: 在 SU(2) 规范理论中加入 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用后，SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ 仍可保持为解禁闭临界性的候选平台，并给出可由 NMR 检验的自旋各向异性预言。
AI.motivation: SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ 是解禁闭临界性的主要候选，但现有临界理论忽略了会打开 kagome Dirac 自旋液体能隙的 DM 相互作用。
AI.method: 将 DM 相互作用加入 SU(2) 规范理论，分析时间反演与自旋-轨道锁定的 glide 对称性对规范单态 spinon 质量项的限制，并区分面内与面外 DM 的作用。
AI.result: 时间反演和自旋-轨道锁定 glide 禁止任意阶的规范单态 spinon 质量；面内 DM 仅扭曲 spinon，并在 0.03–0.17 K 以下重构节点；面外 DM 无关，SO(5) 各向异性仅在二阶出现。
AI.conclusion: 该材料仍是解禁闭临界性的平台；[100] 场诱导 Néel 矩而 [001] 场不诱导，可作为 NMR 实验判据。

title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions in the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids
summary: We classify the fermion bilinears of the SU(2) gauge theory of the Shastry-Sutherland Dirac spin liquids under the spin-orbit-locked space group and treat the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions of SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ at leading order in $1/N$ and at one loop. At linear order DM can neither gap the spinons nor destabilize the SO(5) point above a scale $T^*$. Symmetry forbids every local gauge-singlet fermion mass at any order. Among the singlet bilinears, the in-plane couplings induce only a conserved spin current of dimension exactly 2, which sets $T^*=4\lambda\simeq0.03$-$0.17$ K, and the out-of-plane coupling only a flavored spin-2 current, irrelevant at a unitary critical point. DM-induced Yukawa couplings start below $2\%$ of the one that bounds the pseudocritical window. In zero field, measured samples order above $1$ K, at or above $T^*$. Below $T^*$, in a two-dimensional sample at the critical pressure, the Dirac cones reconstruct into a chirally protected $d$-wave quadratic band touching whose only gauge-singlet gap channels are the two valence-bond components and the scalar chirality. A one-loop flow, with the gauge field screened by the band touching, ends at $T^{**}\sim(0.03$-$0.1)\lambda$ on a ray containing valence-bond order for the material's exchange and for most random couplings, and otherwise on a gapped chiral $\mathbb{Z}_2$ spin liquid. The DM bias between the two plaquette patterns is at most of order $10^{-4}$, with a direction not fixed at $O(1/N)$, whereas non-magnetic quenched disorder couples a relevant random field to the plaquette doublet and none to the chirality. A field along $[100]$ induces a $(\pi,\pi)$ N\'eel moment linear in the field; a field along $[001]$ does not. This selection rule also holds in the dimer phase and is testable by $^{11}$B NMR under pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文对Shastry-Sutherland Dirac自旋液体的SU(2)规范理论中费米双线性项按自旋-轨道锁定的空间群分类，并在1/N领头阶与单圈水平处理SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，指出DM不能打开自旋子能隙或破坏SO(5)点，但会设定一个低温标度并影响低价有序选择。
AI.motivation: 厘清SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$中DM相互作用对Dirac自旋液体稳定性、自旋子激发和低温有序倾向的影响，并利用对称性判断哪些规范单态质量项与低能序参量允许存在。
AI.method: 在自旋-轨道锁定空间群下分类SU(2)规范理论的费米双线性项；将DM相互作用按1/N领头阶和单圈处理；分析规范单态质量项、自旋流算符维度与Yukawa耦合；在Dirac锥重构后对规范场受能带接触屏蔽的系统做单圈重整化群流分析，并讨论无序、DM偏置和外场选择定则。
AI.result: 线性阶DM不能打开自旋子能隙，也不能在$T^*$以上破坏SO(5)点；对称性禁止任意阶的局域规范单态费米质量。面内耦合只诱导维度恰为2的守恒自旋流，给出$T^*=4\lambda\simeq0.03$–$0.17$ K；面外耦合只诱导单位点处不相关的flavored spin-2流。DM诱导的Yukawa耦合小于限制赝临界窗口的耦合的$2\%$。零场下样品在$1$ K以上、即$T^*$附近或以上有序。低于$T^*$时，二维临界压力样品中Dirac锥重构为手征保护的$d$-波二次能带接触，其唯一规范单态能隙通道为两个价键分量和标量手征性。单圈流在$T^{**}\sim(0.03$–$0.1)\lambda$终止：对材料交换和多数随机耦合落在含价键序的射线上，否则进入有能隙的手征$\mathbb{Z}_2$自旋液体。两种plaquette图案的DM偏置至多$10^{-4}$量级且方向在$O(1/N)$未固定；非磁淬火无序只对plaquette双重态耦合相关随机场，对手征性无耦合。沿$[100]$磁场线性诱导$(\pi,\pi)$ Néel矩，沿$[001]$则不诱导；该选择定则在二聚相也成立，并可由压力下$^{11}$B NMR检验。
AI.conclusion: DM在领头阶很弱，不能直接使Dirac自旋液体失稳，但设定$T^*$并在更低温度通过Dirac锥重构和单圈流决定价键序或有能隙手征$\mathbb{Z}_2$自旋液体；外场方向选择定则提供了可实验检验的判据。

title: Ferroelastic domain wall driven glassy dynamics and photoresponse in a SrTiO$_3$ (111) two-dimensional electron gas
summary: The (111) orientation of SrTiO$_3$ (STO)-based heterostructures has emerged as a versatile platform for two-dimensional electron gases (2DEGs), yet the influence of STO's polar ferroelastic domain-wall (DW) network on charge transport remains largely unexplored. Here we study AlO$_x$/STO (111) interfaces hosting 2DEGs of different carrier densities. In the lower-density 2DEG, low-temperature transport exhibits thermal hysteresis, slow resistance relaxation, cooling-rate dependence, and memory effects, signaling glasslike electron dynamics. The relaxation is strongly non-monotonic in temperature, increasing below $\sim$80 K, peaking near 25 K, and vanishing below $\sim$12 K, tracking the established evolution of the ferroelastic DW state of bulk STO rather than any electronic energy scale, which identifies the DW network as its origin. These signatures are absent in a second, more metallic interface with much higher carrier density, demonstrating that the electron-DW coupling can be tuned. We further show that polar DWs govern the photoresponse: the persistent photoconductivity rises sharply below $\sim$80 K, coinciding with the onset of DW polarity. Together, these results establish polar ferroelastic DWs as a carrier-density-tunable electronic degree of freedom in STO (111)-based 2DEGs, opening routes to manipulate 2DEG properties through topological defects.

AI.tldr: 该文研究AlOx/SrTiO3(111)界面二维电子气（2DEG）与STO极性铁弹畴壁（DW）网络的耦合，发现低载流子密度2DEG表现出玻璃态电子动力学和畴壁主导的光响应，且耦合强度可由载流子密度调控。
AI.motivation: STO(111)基异质结是2DEG的重要平台，但STO极性铁弹畴壁网络对电荷输运的影响尚不清楚，作者旨在揭示畴壁是否以及如何作为可调电子自由度影响2DEG。
AI.method: 制备不同载流子密度的AlOx/STO(111)界面2DEG，并进行低温输运测量（热滞、电阻弛豫、降温速率依赖、记忆效应）及光电导测量，将输运特征与块体STO铁弹畴壁态的温度演化进行对比。
AI.result: 低密度2DEG在低温下出现热滞、慢电阻弛豫、降温速率依赖和记忆效应，表现为玻璃态电子动力学；弛豫随温度非单调变化，在约80 K以下增强、25 K附近达峰、12 K以下消失，其温度尺度与STO铁弹畴壁态演化一致而非电子能标。高载流子密度的更金属性界面中这些特征消失，表明电子-畴壁耦合可调。持续光电导在约80 K以下显著增强，与畴壁极性的出现相吻合。
AI.conclusion: 极性铁弹畴壁是STO(111)基2DEG中可由载流子密度调控的电子自由度，可通过拓扑缺陷调控2DEG性质，为相关器件和物理研究提供新途径。

title: Coupling Evaporation, Chemical Reactions, and Crystallization: A Population-Balance Framework Applied to Two-Step Perovskite Crystallization
summary: A limited understanding of how evaporation couples to crystallization pathways hampers control over the formation of solution-processed perovskite photoactive layers. Identifying these mechanisms-and learning how to select and tune them-is essential for achieving the desired crystal morphology and, ultimately, improving solar-cell performance and stability. To investigate crystallization pathways in evaporating thin films, we develop a simple and general zero-dimensional population-balance model that couples evaporation, chemical reactions, and crystallization. We use the model to explore a range of parameters for a solvent-solute system that follows a two-step crystallization pathway: solvent evaporation first induces formation of a crystalline precursor, which subsequently recrystallizes into the final phase. The model predicts the evolution of the film composition during drying and provides quantitative LaMer curves. Based on these results, we introduce a vocabulary of "supply limitations" and "rate limitations" that enables the interpretation of crystallization kinetics in terms of the governing process conditions.

AI.tldr: 该文建立零维群体平衡模型，将蒸发、化学反应与结晶耦合，用于解析钙钛矿薄膜干燥过程中的两步结晶路径，并提出以供给限制和速率限制解释结晶动力学的术语体系。
AI.motivation: 目前对蒸发如何与结晶路径耦合的理解有限，制约了溶液加工钙钛矿光活性层的结晶形貌调控，而这对提升太阳能电池性能与稳定性至关重要。
AI.method: 构建简单且通用的零维群体平衡模型，耦合蒸发、化学反应和结晶；针对遵循两步结晶路径的溶剂-溶质体系扫描参数：蒸发先诱导 crystalline precursor 形成，随后再结晶为最终相；模型预测干燥过程中膜组成演化并给出定量 LaMer 曲线。
AI.result: 模型能够预测薄膜组成随干燥的演化，并给出定量 LaMer 曲线；基于结果提出 supply limitations 与 rate limitations 的分类词汇，用于从过程条件角度解释结晶动力学。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了连接蒸发、反应与结晶的通用建模框架，并通过供给限制/速率限制术语帮助选择和调控结晶路径，以指导钙钛矿薄膜形貌及器件性能与稳定性的优化。

title: Challenging Atomistic Foundation Models on Disordered Carbons
summary: Foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) promise broad transferability, yet their out-of-domain reliability is hard to establish. Here, we use pure and O/H-containing disordered carbon spanning multiple phases, competing hybridisations and porous frameworks to stress-test six popular foundation MLIPs. We first screen all six on density functional theory (DFT) energy and force errors and binding curves, then subject four to melt-quench-anneal molecular dynamics and evaluate the resulting structural observables. Binding curves and O/H-containing trajectories reveal unphysical extrapolation and dynamical failures that low DFT energy and force errors fail to reveal. Of the models tested, MACE-MH-1 is the most consistently robust, with low DFT errors and stable MD. Despite differing architectures, OMAT-based models share structural biases, highlighting the importance of training coverage. All four models generate structures of nanoporous carbon that reproduce the principal experimental and specialised carbon potential signatures. Incorporating O/H leaves short-range order largely unchanged but shifts pore-size distributions towards larger pores. These results emphasise the need for application-specific validation and extend molecular dynamics modelling of nanoporous carbon towards experimentally realistic structures.

AI.tldr: 该文对六种基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）在无序碳及含O/H体系中进行域外压力测试，发现低DFT误差不足以保证动力学可靠性，MACE-MH-1综合表现最稳健。
AI.motivation: 基础MLIP宣称具有广泛迁移性，但其域外可靠性难以建立；需要针对多相、竞争杂化及多孔骨架等复杂碳体系验证其外推与动力学稳定性。
AI.method: 以纯碳及含O/H无序碳为对象，先基于DFT能量/力误差和结合曲线筛选六种MLIP，再对其中四种进行熔融-淬火-退火分子动力学并评估结构观测量。
AI.result: 结合曲线和含O/H轨迹揭示低DFT误差未暴露的非物理外推与动力学失效；MACE-MH-1误差低且MD稳定；不同架构的OMAT类模型共享结构偏差，体现训练覆盖的重要性；四种模型生成的纳米多孔碳复现主要实验及专用碳势特征，含O/H基本不改变短程有序但使孔径分布向大孔偏移。
AI.conclusion: MLIP需按应用场景验证；该工作将纳米多孔碳的MD建模推进至更接近实验现实的结构，并强调训练数据覆盖对结构偏差的关键影响。

title: A project of the thermal triple axis spectrometer at the PIK reactor
summary: A project of the novel thermal triple axis spectrometer IN1 at the PIK reactor is presented. Monte Carlo simulations were used for optimization its main parameters. The optimization of the instrument gives an estimated neutron flux as high as 109 n/cm2/s at the sample position at neutron energy about 36 meV at the designed 100 MW power. The modelling of neutron stages like monochromators, analyzers, virtual source, as well as instrument shielding was fulfilled to obtain the best performance of the spectrometer.

AI.tldr: 介绍了 PIK 反应堆新型热中子三轴谱仪 IN1 的项目方案，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟优化其参数与中子部件。
AI.motivation: 为在 PIK 反应堆 100 MW 设计功率下获得高性能热中子三轴谱仪，需要对 IN1 的主要参数和中子传输/屏蔽进行优化设计。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡罗模拟优化谱仪主要参数，并对单色器、分析器、虚拟源以及仪器屏蔽等中子级联环节进行建模。
AI.result: 优化后估计样品位置中子通量可达约 10^9 n/cm²/s，中子能量约 36 meV（对应 100 MW 设计功率）。
AI.conclusion: 模拟结果表明 IN1 的优化设计可获得高通量且性能较优的热中子三轴谱仪方案。

title: Finite-size scaling of spin-wave scattering and enhancement in magnonic Fabry-P\'erot nanoresonators
summary: Magnonic neural networks require compact resonant nodes that scatter spin waves efficiently, concentrate spin-wave energy and can be reconfigured. Hybrid magnonic Fabry-P\'erot resonators, formed by a ferromagnetic-metal stripe dipolar-coupled to a yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film, provide low-loss and programmable control of spin-wave transmission, but have so far been studied only for stripes that are long compared with the spin-wave wavelength. Here we use micromagnetic simulations to determine how the response of a 200-nm-wide CoFeB stripe on a 55-nm-thick YIG film evolves as the stripe length is reduced from infinity to 640 nm. An infinitely long stripe acts as a one-dimensional cavity that opens a transmission gap at the first-order resonance (1.70 GHz and 1.47 GHz for the parallel and antiparallel magnetic configuration) and enhances the out-of-plane precession amplitude in the YIG film by factors of about 5 and 12, without distorting the transmitted wavefront. For lengths of a few micrometers, backward-volume spin waves emitted from the stripe ends modulate the precession along the stripe and fragment the reflected and transmitted wavefronts. Below about 1.2 micrometer, the resonator scatters incident spin waves over the entire isofrequency contour of the film, with caustic beams that are most pronounced in the antiparallel configuration. In this regime the parallel configuration supports weakly enhanced quantized modes, whereas the antiparallel configuration supports a single mode with an out-of-plane enhancement of about 15. The width, thickness and shape of the stripe tune this mode by 50-100 MHz, and its strong enhancement lowers the onset of nonlinear frequency shift and fold-over to incident amplitudes of a few percent of the saturation magnetization. Sub-micrometer magnonic resonators are therefore promising reconfigurable nonlinear nodes for magnonic networks.

AI.tldr: 该文用微磁模拟研究CoFeB条带/YIG薄膜构成的混合磁振子Fabry-Pérot谐振器，随条带长度缩短至亚微米尺度，其自旋波散射、模式量子化、焦散和增强效应显著变化，表明亚微米磁振子谐振器可作为可重构非线性节点。
AI.motivation: 磁振子神经网络需要紧凑、能高效散射自旋波、集中自旋波能量且可重构的谐振节点；现有混合磁振子Fabry-Pérot谐振器仅研究过长条带情形，缺乏对短条带/亚微米条带响应的理解。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟研究200 nm宽CoFeB条带置于55 nm厚YIG薄膜上的混合谐振器，将条带长度从无限长逐步缩短至640 nm，并比较平行与反平行磁构型下的自旋波传输、反射、进动增强和模式演化。
AI.result: 无限长条带表现为一维腔，在平行/反平行构型的一阶共振1.70 GHz/1.47 GHz处打开传输带隙，并使YIG面外进动幅度分别增强约5倍和12倍且不扭曲透射波前；几微米长时条带端部发射的后向体自旋波调制条带内进动并破碎反射/透射波前；低于约1.2 μm时谐振器在整个等频轮廓上散射入射自旋波并产生焦散束，反平行构型更显著，此时平行构型支持弱增强量子化模式，反平行构型支持单一模式且面外增强约15倍；条带宽度、厚度和形状可调谐该模式50–100 MHz，强增强使非线性频移与折叠的起始入射幅度降至饱和磁化强度的百分之几。
AI.conclusion: 亚微米磁振子谐振器具有强场增强、模式可调和低阈值非线性等特性，是有前景的可重构非线性节点，可用于磁振子网络。

title: Two quantum spin liquid states coexisting in the kagome antiferromagnet herbertsmithite
summary: Herbertsmithite (ZnCu$_3$(OH)$_6$Cl$_2$) is one of the most extensively studied quantum spin liquid (QSL) candidates, yet the precise nature of its ground state remains unresolved. Here, we compare the results of high-resolution inelastic neutron scattering on single crystals of herbertsmithite (Zn$_\mathrm{x}$Cu$_\mathrm{4-x}$(OD)$_6$Cl$_2$, $x\simeq 0.85$) with large-scale density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and dynamical DMRG simulations to benchmark the spin Hamiltonian and uncover fundamental properties of the ground state. The measured spin correlations determine an energy density for the Heisenberg model that closely matches simulations, an essential verification of the Hamiltonian. In parallel, DMRG simulations reveal two nearly degenerate QSL states. Both preserve translational symmetry, but one retains the lattice point-group symmetries whereas the other develops anisotropic spin correlations that break point-group symmetry. These two QSLs have distinct spin structure factors, and, remarkably, close agreement with the neutron spectra is achieved with an admixture of the two states. Our results establish a quantitative correspondence between neutron scattering and simulations, and suggest that herbertsmithite realizes a regime in which two proximate gapped QSL states coexist.

AI.tldr: 通过高分辨非弹性中子散射与大尺度DMRG/动态DMRG对比，作者发现Herbertsmithite的基态可能由两个近简并的有能隙量子自旋液体态混合描述。
AI.motivation: Herbertsmithite是研究最广泛的量子自旋液体候选材料之一，但其基态性质仍不明确；需要定量检验自旋哈密顿量并揭示基态本质。
AI.method: 对单晶Zn$_\mathrm{x}$Cu$_{4-x}$(OD)$_6$Cl$_2$（$x\simeq0.85$）进行高分辨非弹性中子散射，并与大尺度DMRG及动态DMRG模拟比较；由测量自旋关联确定Heisenberg模型能量密度，并计算自旋结构因子。
AI.result: 测得自旋关联给出的能量密度与模拟高度吻合；DMRG给出两个近简并有能隙QSL态，二者均保持平移对称性，但其中一个保持点群对称性，另一个具有各向异性自旋关联并破坏点群对称性；两态自旋结构因子不同，且中子谱可由两态混合获得很好符合。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了中子散射与数值模拟之间的定量对应，表明Herbertsmithite处于两个邻近有能隙QSL态共存的区域。

title: Kohler's Rule Holds in the Strange Metallic Hubbard Model
summary: Unconventional magnetotransport violating Kohler's rule has been reported in many strongly correlated strange metals, but the exact origin of these violations is yet unknown. To investigate this question, we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo to compute the magnetoresistance of the hole-doped Hubbard-Hofstadter model. Despite $T$-linear resistivity exceeding the Mott-Ioffe-Regel limit and the nominal absence of well-defined quasiparticles, we find Kohler's rule unexpectedly holds across a wide range of on-site interaction strengths and hole dopings. In particular, Kohler emerges below a crossover temperature $T^\star\approx t$ identified from the double occupancy and specific heat, coinciding with the onset of local singlet correlations between lattice sites. We thus propose that Kohler scaling in this regime reflects a more general form of many-body quantum coherence. Our results show that strong correlations and strange metallicity do not themselves generically produce anomalous magnetoresistance.

AI.tldr: 在空穴掺杂的Hubbard-Hofstadter模型中，尽管体系表现出奇异金属行为，Kohler定则仍在很宽参数范围内成立，其出现与局域单态关联及多体量子相干相关。
AI.motivation: 许多强关联奇异金属表现出违反Kohler定则的非常规磁输运，但其确切来源尚不清楚；本文旨在检验强关联和奇异金属性是否必然导致异常磁阻。
AI.method: 采用行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant quantum Monte Carlo）计算空穴掺杂Hubbard-Hofstadter模型的磁阻，并扫描不同在位相互作用强度和空穴掺杂浓度。
AI.result: 尽管电阻率呈T线性并超过Mott-Ioffe-Regel极限，且名义上没有良好定义的准粒子，Kohler定则仍出乎意料地在广泛参数范围内成立；Kohler行为在由双占据数和比热识别的交叉温度T*≈t以下出现，并与格点间局域单态关联的起始相吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该区域的Kohler标度反映的是一种更普遍的多体量子相干形式；强关联和奇异金属性本身并不普遍产生异常磁阻。

title: Microwave probing of magnetic phases in a dipolar-exchange magnet LiGdF$_4$
summary: We report the results of low-temperature magnetic resonance measurements performed on a single-crystal sample of a weakly anisotropic dipolar-exchange antiferromagnet LiGdF$_4$. The transformation of a resonance spectrum due to the formation of the ordered phase is observed at temperatures below $T_N=0.19(1)$ K. A sequence of field-induced phase transitions is detected for the external magnetic field applied along the fourfold axis of the crystal. A well-resolved magnetic resonance spectrum is observed in one of the low-field magnetic phases as well as above the saturation field. Competing exchange and dipolar interactions, as a special type of magnetic frustration, are suggested to account for the delayed ordering and complex magnetic phase diagram of the system.

AI.tldr: 对LiGdF4单晶的低温柔性磁共振测量揭示了低于TN=0.19(1) K的有序相形成、沿四重轴磁场诱导的一系列相变，以及交换与偶极相互作用竞争导致的磁阻挫和复杂相图。
AI.motivation: 研究弱各向异性偶极-交换反铁磁体LiGdF4中交换相互作用与偶极相互作用的竞争，以及这种特殊磁阻挫如何影响有序化和磁场诱导的磁相行为。
AI.method: 对LiGdF4单晶样品进行低温磁共振测量，观测共振谱随温度降低至TN以下的变化，并对外磁场沿晶体四重轴方向施加时的场诱导相变序列进行测量。
AI.result: 在TN=0.19(1) K以下观察到由有序相形成引起的共振谱转变；沿四重轴施加外磁场时检测到一系列场诱导相变；在其中一个低场磁相以及饱和场以上均观察到分辨良好的磁共振谱。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的交换与偶极相互作用作为一种特殊类型的磁阻挫，可解释该体系有序化被延迟以及复杂的磁相图。

title: Large exchange bias from coupled antiferromagnetic order and glassy magnetic freezing in $Co_{0.36}NbS_{2}$
summary: Magnetization measurements on single-crystalline $Co_{0.36}NbS_{2}$ reveal antiferromagnetic order near $T_{N} \simeq 26 K$ and a lower-temperature history-dependent magnetic response consistent with glassy freezing of a subset of magnetic moments. After field cooling, $M(H)$ loops exhibit a sizable exchange-bias shift, reaching $|H_{EB}| \simeq 4.4 kOe$ at $1.8 K$ for a $70 kOe$ field-cooling sweep protocol. The training effect, field-sweep and cooling-field protocol dependence, and disappearance of the bias near a blocking temperature $T_{B} \simeq 12 K$, well below $T_{N}$, support an interpretation in which frozen uncompensated moments are exchange-coupled to an antiferromagnetic matrix. These results suggest that antiferromagnetic-glassy-moment coupling may provide a broader route to exchange bias in off-stoichiometric magnetic $NbS_{2}$ intercalates.

AI.tldr: 单晶Co0.36NbS2中观察到TN≈26 K的反铁磁序及低于TN的历史依赖玻璃态磁行为；场冷后出现显著交换偏置，1.8 K、70 kOe场冷下|HEB|≈4.4 kOe，并在TB≈12 K附近消失。
AI.motivation: 探究非化学计量磁性NbS2插层化合物中交换偏置的来源，特别是反铁磁基体与玻璃态冻结磁矩耦合是否可提供更广泛的交换偏置机制。
AI.method: 对单晶Co0.36NbS2进行磁化测量，包括场冷/零场冷、M(H)磁滞回线、不同场扫和冷却场协议以及训练效应测量，并与TN和TB比较。
AI.result: 确认TN≈26 K的反铁磁序和低温历史依赖磁响应；场冷后M(H)回线出现交换偏置，1.8 K时|HEB|≈4.4 kOe（70 kOe场冷）；偏置随训练效应、场扫和冷却场协议变化，并在TB≈12 K（远低于TN）附近消失。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持冻结的非补偿磁矩与反铁磁基体交换耦合导致交换偏置；反铁磁-玻璃态磁矩耦合可能是非化学计量磁性NbS2插层物中实现交换偏置的通用途径。

title: Frustration-Assisted Electrical Switching in $Co_xTaS_2$
summary: Electrical switching in antiferromagnets is commonly described as the action of current-induced torques on a rigid order parameter. In frustrated magnets, however, competing states can create a history-dependent energy landscape in which slow collective dynamics actively participate in electrical reconfiguration. Here, we demonstrate frustration-assisted switching in near-stoichiometric $Co_xTaS_2$, a van der Waals antiferromagnet located at the composition-sensitive boundary between Hall-active and Hall-inactive multi-Q-related magnetic regimes. Although the crystals exhibit no resolved spontaneous Hall response, they retain van Hove singularities near the Fermi level and order antiferromagnetically below $T_N \simeq 31.5 K$. Current pulses write nonvolatile anisotropic resistance states in microstructured devices, with an activation current density nearly an order of magnitude below that reported for the Hall-active lower-intercalation phase. The switching response separates into two temperature-dependent dynamical regimes rather than following a single current threshold. Independent magnetization-aging and post-field-relaxation measurements reveal slow, history-dependent magnetic dynamics, and the relaxation strength closely follows the inverse switching amplitude. These results identify magnetic frustration and glassy dynamics as central ingredients in the electrical reconfiguration of $Co_xTaS_2$, establishing a route to functional switching through a dynamically soft antiferromagnetic landscape.

AI.tldr: 在近化学计量比 Co_xTaS_2 中，利用磁阻挫和玻璃态动力学实现了低电流密度、非易失的各向异性电阻切换。
AI.motivation: 传统反铁磁电切换通常被描述为电流诱导力矩作用于刚性序参量；但在阻挫磁体中，竞争磁态可形成历史依赖的能量景观，慢集体动力学可能主动参与电重构，因此需要研究其切换机制。
AI.method: 研究位于 Hall-active 与 Hall-inactive 多 Q 相关磁区边界附近的近化学计量比范德华反铁磁体 Co_xTaS_2；该材料无分辨的自发 Hall 响应，但费米能级附近保留 van Hove 奇点，并在 T_N ≈ 31.5 K 以下反铁磁有序。通过微结构器件施加电流脉冲写入非易失各向异性电阻态，并进行变温切换响应、磁化老化及后场弛豫测量。
AI.result: 电流脉冲可写入非易失各向异性电阻态，激活电流密度比 Hall-active 低插层相报道值低近一个数量级；切换响应随温度分为两个动力学区间，而非遵循单一电流阈值；磁化老化与后场弛豫揭示慢的、历史依赖磁动力学，且弛豫强度与切换幅度近似成反比。
AI.conclusion: 磁阻挫和玻璃态动力学是 Co_xTaS_2 电重构的核心因素，表明可通过动态软化的反铁磁能量景观实现功能切换。

title: Categorical classification of non-Fermi liquids in 2+1 dimensions
summary: A defining feature of non-Fermi liquids is a lack of the quasiparticle peak on the Fermi surface in the spectral function, which is usually realized by coupling a finite density of fermions with critical collective fluctuations. However, these features of the two- and three-point vertex functions are qualitatively the same across many non-Fermi liquids, which has made it difficult to classify them beyond the definition by negation. We point out that the four-point function in the pairing channel contains rich information that positively differentiates distinct types of non-Fermi liquids. Using the generalized notion of fixed points that captures scale-dependent universal pairing interaction, we provide a non-perturbative classification of 2+1-dimensional non-Fermi liquids. In the large Fermi momentum limit with fixed dimensionless couplings, metals coupled with long-wavelength critical fluctuations are classified into seven superuniversality classes. Each of them exhibits a unique phase diagram in the space of temperature and bare four-fermion coupling. The present work generalizes the earlier perturbative classification to strongly interacting non-Fermi liquids by leveraging kinematic constraints.

AI.tldr: 该文利用配对通道的四点函数和广义固定点概念，对2+1维非费米液体进行非微扰分类，得到七个超普适类。
AI.motivation: 非费米液体的二点和三点顶点函数在多种体系中定性相似，难以超越“无准粒子峰”的否定式定义进行分类。
AI.method: 作者关注配对通道的四点函数，采用可刻画尺度依赖普适配对相互作用的广义固定点，并在大费米动量极限和固定无量纲耦合下进行非微扰分析。
AI.result: 耦合长波长临界涨落的金属被分为七个超普适类，每一类在温度和裸四费米耦合参数空间中具有独特的相图。
AI.conclusion: 配对通道四点函数可正面区分不同类型的非费米液体；该工作借助运动学约束将先前的微扰分类推广到强相互作用的非费米液体。

title: Methods of density functional theory in one dimension
summary: Density functional theory is formally justified by an existence proof. As such, the need for computational methods to study the theory is a useful route to understanding the full theory. In this paper, we discuss the numerical strategies to efficiently evaluate computations for Kohn-Sham systems in one dimension and also methods for determining exact properties, including time-dependence. An accompanying library is also available for computing one-dimensional density functional theory and publicly available. The expressions used to implement the density functional in one-dimension are surveyed. An alternative justification for a gradient-based technique is also shown that can be applied to time-dependent evolution of the exact Kohn-Sham potential.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论一维Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论的高效数值计算策略、精确性质（含时间依赖）的求解方法，并发布配套的可公开获取的一维DFT计算库。
AI.motivation: 密度泛函理论仅由存在性证明在形式上得到保证，因此借助计算方法研究该理论是理解完整理论的有效途径，需要高效且可复现的数值工具。
AI.method: 综述一维密度泛函实现所需表达式，讨论一维Kohn-Sham系统的高效数值策略，并给出一种可应用于精确Kohn-Sham势时间演化的梯度型技术的替代性论证。
AI.result: 提供了用于一维密度泛函理论计算的可公开获取库，并给出计算精确性质（包括时间依赖）的方法及梯度型技术在时变精确Kohn-Sham势演化中的论证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过数值方法、表达式综述和公开库促进一维Kohn-Sham DFT的高效计算，并为含时精确Kohn-Sham势演化提供方法基础，有助于深入理解密度泛函理论。

title: Evidence of valence bond solid and quantum paramagnetism in the $J_1$--$J_2$--$J_3$ Heisenberg model from pseudofermion functional renormalization group
summary: Motivated by recent tensor network studies reporting a quantum spin liquid (QSL) within the quantum paramagnetic (QP) regime, we investigate numerically the zero-temperature phase diagram of the $J_1$--$J_2$--$J_3$ Heisenberg model on the square lattice using the pseudofermion functional renormalization group (pf-fRG). Thanks to improved frequency resolution and larger lattice truncations, we are able to explore a significantly larger parameter space than previous pf-fRG work to map out the phase boundary of an extended QP region. We further resolve possible bond order within the QP regime by measuring the dimer response to small deformations in $J_1$, i.e. bond anisotropy that breaks the point-group symmetry of the Hamiltonian. The functional renormalization group flow of the dimer susceptibility suggests that the QP window splits into two: a region where it grows continuously down to the lowest energy scale to signal valence bond solid (VBS) order, and another region where it reaches a peak at a finite scale and is subsequently suppressed to indicate a QSL.

AI.tldr: 利用改进的pf-fRG数值研究方形晶格J1-J2-J3海森堡模型的零温相图，并通过二聚体响应区分量子顺磁区中的VBS与量子自旋液体。
AI.motivation: 近期张量网络研究报道量子顺磁区中存在量子自旋液体，促使作者系统检验该区域内可能的键序与自旋液体行为。
AI.method: 采用赝费米子泛函重整化群（pf-fRG），提升频率分辨率并扩大晶格截断，扫描更大参数空间以确定扩展量子顺磁区边界；同时施加破坏点群对称性的微小J1键各向异性，测量二聚体磁化率响应。
AI.result: pf-fRG流显示量子顺磁窗口分裂为两部分：一处二聚体磁化率持续增长至最低能标，指示价键固体序；另一处磁化率在有限能标出现峰值后被抑制，指示量子自旋液体。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明方形晶格J1-J2-J3模型中扩展量子顺磁区可包含VBS与QSL两类不同基态，二聚体磁化率的能标流可作为区分二者的判据。

title: High-order resonances and emergent coherent dynamics in interacting Stark chains
summary: A linear potential gradient can strongly suppress quantum dynamics, while interactions can activate resonant many-body processes whose higher-order structure remains largely unexplored.
